overall_summary: Analysis of measured YouTube Shorts performance for THINK FAST DAILY reveals exceptionally strong engagement for high-difficulty sequence puzzles (e.g., 'Only 5% Can Solve This Fast IQ Sequence!') reaching 185% average view percentage, alongside solid performance in general knowledge quizzes like geography and history. Content categories focusing on high curiosity gaps, clear spatial or numerical challenges, and immediate visual engagement perform best, while recent unlaunched or late-published clips require scheduling adjustments.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Only 5% Can Solve This Fast IQ Sequence!' achieved 205 views, 97 estimated minutes watched, and a phenomenal 185.04% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Reinforce this pattern by producing more elite-tier logic puzzles with explicit difficulty filters ('Only 5% Can Solve...') that encourage re-watches.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes? 🌊 Geography Quiz!' drove 408 views, 56 estimated minutes watched, and 67.66% average view percentage with 16 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Continue creating accessible geography and high-interest trivia questions framed around surprising world facts.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Guess The Object Quiz!' generated 248 views and 54.84% average view percentage with 10 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate visual guessing hooks centered around historical or unexpected utility objects.

improvements.pattern: Low Retention on Complex Calendar Trick Questions
improvements.evidence: 'Can You Solve This Calendar Trick Question? 🧠' dropped to 30.89% average view percentage and 10 seconds average view duration.
improvements.action: Simplify the framing of word/calendar math puzzles so viewers grasp the core premise within the first 2 seconds.

improvements.evidence: Several recent videos published across mid-day and evening hours (e.g., 17:12 UTC) received zero views, indicating sub-optimal timing or lack of algorithmic push.
improvements.action: Consolidate uploads around proven high-engagement morning windows identified in active analytics.

retention_insights.evidence: 'Only 5% Can Solve This Fast IQ Sequence!' maintained an audience watch ratio above 2.0 through 25% of the video progress.
retention_insights.action: Keep initial pacing rapid and use on-screen countdown timers to sustain loop viewing and high relative retention.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Geography Trivia ('Which Country Has The Most Lakes?')
retention_insights.evidence: Relative retention remained stable and even increased toward 46% at 49% video progress.
retention_insights.action: Structure trivia delivery so the reveal happens right near the midpoint, encouraging viewers to stay until the end.

best_posting_windows.reason: Observed successful uploads like 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' and 'Can You Solve This Calendar Trick Question?' were published around 06:45 UTC, aligning with high initial engagement.
Successful space and physics quizzes like 'Can You Guess Which Planet Spins Backwards?' were published around 12:40 UTC, capturing midday active audiences.
